requirement_text: Add six translucent citrus-colored bubbles that gently orbit around the user's face, following the face as it moves. A tap anywhere on the screen should cycle through three coordinated color palettes. The host clears the transparent overlay canvas before each frame and calls onFrame with {ctx, width, height, faces, time}; it also provides onTap(callback). Each face has normalized [0,1] landmarks leftEye, rightEye, and nose.
